title: FileReadRequested
description: Command: read a file under the File Storage Adapter's watch_dir (Design.md §8, §13 Step F2). Logical, pre-encryption shape of eventPayload — the wire envelope wraps this per §5.

path.description: File path, relative to watch_dir, to read. Must resolve to a location inside watch_dir — absolute paths, '..' traversal, and symlink escapes are rejected by the adapter (Design.md §12/§13), not by this schema.
